title: Tune without restarting
description: Declare a speed parameter and read it on every timer callback. Change it live from a terminal while Python keeps running.
steps: Read node.get_parameter("speed").value inside the timer, clamp it to 0–0.8, and publish Twist.
While running: ros2 param list; ros2 param get /student_controller speed; ros2 param set /student_controller speed 0.6. Observe the change, then check.
hints: Parameters belong to nodes, not topics.
Reading once during startup will not apply later updates to your controller.
Keep the timer running; use node.get_parameter("speed").value inside tick.
